shortDescription: NetApp ONTAP create, delete, or modify vserver security file-directory policy

options.name: access_control
options.description: Specifies the access control of task to be applied.

options.name: cert_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client cert file (.pem). not supported with python 2.6.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the ONTAP instance.

options.name: http_port
options.description: Override the default port (80 or 443) with this port

options.name: https
options.description: Enable and disable https. Ignored when using REST as only https is supported. Ignored when using SSL certificate authentication as it requires SSL.

options.name: ignore_broken_symlinks
options.description: Skip Broken Symlinks. Options used when applying the policy to vserver.

options.name: key_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client key file.

options.name: ntfs_mode
options.description: Specifies NTFS Propagation Mode.

options.name: ntfs_sd
options.description: Specifies NTFS security descriptor identifier.

options.name: ontapi
options.description: The ontap api version to use

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the specified user.

options.name: path
options.description: Specifies the file or folder path of the task. If path is specified and the policy which the task is adding to, does not exist, it will create the policy first then add the task to it. If path is specified, delete operation only removes task from policy.

options.name: policy_name
options.description: Specifies the name of the policy.

options.name: security_type
options.description: Specifies the type of security.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified policy or task should exist or not.

options.name: use_rest
options.description: This module only supports ZAPI and can not be swtiched to REST. never -- will always use ZAPI if the module supports ZAPI.  An error may be issued if a REST option is not supported in ZAPI. auto -- will always use ZAPI.

options.name: username
options.description: This can be a Cluster-scoped or SVM-scoped account, depending on whether a Cluster-level or SVM-level API is required. For more information, please read the documentation U(https://docs.netapp.com/us-en/ontap/authentication/create-svm-user-accounts-task.html). Two authentication methods are supported 1. options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to C(no), the SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(False) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vserver
options.description: Specifies the vserver for the policy.
